title: Gender Gap in Startup Recruiting: Evidence from Changes in Termination Costs
eligible_reason: Regression discontinuity in time around a single reform date (November 2011, Portugal) with individual-level data and gender x startup interactions. The firm-level DiD in the appendix (Table A7) compares startups vs. incumbents around the same single date. One adoption date, treatment defined by a time-invariant firm type, no staggered cohorts.
design_notes: Main specification is individual-level RDiT with hiring-month fixed effects, age, education and industry controls, and a time-trend function f(Time) interacted with Post. The text explicitly says a firm-level DiD 'would have no real control group because all firms are affected by the reform'. Data from Quadro de Pessoal (Portuguese mandatory employer survey).
screener_notes: Ineligible: single reform date, RDiT. QDP matched employer-employee data is restricted-access.
